comments.value:
I can't edit this post, but I'd like to elaborate a little more on my stance regarding this issue:

I understand VRChat is a business, and that they need to make money. I can tell that many of the ideas brought forth for this UI redesign are ideas from Discord. It's clear that profile decorations are profitable for Discord, so I understand why VRChat thinks it's a good idea. They have employees to pay and servers costs after all. 

I am not completely against the idea of profile decorations, I think that as long as I am not forced to look at it *all the time* while in game, it's totally fine - i.e, if it's contained in people's personal profiles that I have to click on to see. 

Where it starts to cross a line for me is how it's visible on nameplates, and to an extent, in the list of users in an instance. It breaks up an otherwise pretty clean and consistent aesthetic. It adds visual noise and clutter, and I personally think it's just simply ugly. The current "reference cube" designs are not *too* obnoxious, but I fear that it might be a slippery slope to way more obnoxious and flashy decorations. 

I think the main problem for me is the colors. The decorations changing the color of the entire nameplates is a really big change. If it was more akin to some of the main menu themes, where you have different designs/patterns but with the same color scheme, it wouldn't be as problematic. 

I feel like if there was a time to take a step back and reconsider these decorations, it's *now*, before more dev time is invested in creating more nameplate decorations.
We're not going to remove nameplate decorations, sorry. If they're too noisy for you, nameplate opacity (set it to 0%) and hiding nameplates entirely are both still there in settings.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name} hiding nameplates doesn't solve anything though? How are you supposed to use nameplates for their intended purpose if they're hidden? Since this update I've had nameplates hidden more often than I ever had before and am constantly toggling them so I don't waste more time in any menus. Nameplate opacity just makes nameplates harder to read and doesn't help at all. 

I understand what money is and why yall need it, but even if we can't turn off profile decor, why not for nameplates? They've been the biggest annoyance of these new nameplates since the update dropped and I can't find myself leaving nameplates on at all and don't even use them anymore because the decor is just an eyesore of moving colors. I genuinely cannot keep them on as they are a major focal distraction and add more colorful nonsense to what is already a nightmare of shader effects and lack of color theory in populated instances. Tag on top of the fact that the nameplates are also much darker they're more of a nuisance to use at a glance and are harsher on the eyes even without any decor. I couldn't in my right mind find contrast to be a better solution when old nameplates weren't so contrasting. I actually avoid contrast toggles in other programs accessibility because they hurt my eyes more. Higher contrast is headache inducing for me in quite a lot of scenarios and is why I avoid heavy sunlight with sunglasses and shade IRL. Bright light, vivid colors, and a heavy, hot vr headset with a bunch of attachments doesn't help as that's already a pain in the neck. (literally) I can't just lower brightness because then I am straining my eyes to see, I use a Quest Pro so things are already difficult.

Nameplates currently in beta are actually a struggle for me, turning off the vivid colors and local dimming in VD doesn't help. I'm having a hard time here and I do feel like money is actually taking over actual accessibility and that's coming from someone who rarely needs any accessibility features. Older nameplates were so much better with the grey than this new design. They felt just right. Never had an issue with them at all. There was no forcing information to be within the nameplate itself rather everything had its own little bubble and space to keep things readable and completely legible. This whole nameplate thing is completely disappointing. We lost actual accessibility that was built in by design WITHOUT having to create new measures to address issues that never existed previously. I do hope my take here means something. I'm not trying to be a downer or doomer. Just not particularly interested in my experience being downgraded at the expense of other users getting to be happier than me.
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name} I would like a feature to turn off the decorations at least.

details:
Nameplate decorations create too much visual noise, and make it harder to read text on nameplates. I play with nameplates off most of the time because I find them to be too distracting and ruin the immersion. When I bring up nameplates using the quick menu, it's because I want to be able to read information as quickly as possible, i.e usernames, statues, group banners. Nameplate decorations make this harder, as I now need to visually separate the text from the now differently colored backgrounds. 

Profile decorations are already obnoxious on discord, but at the very least they are only visible when you look at someone's profile. I think that as long as VRC keeps profile decorations to user's profile pages, I'm okay with it. Putting it on nameplates takes it too far.
title: [1878] Remove *nameplate* decorations entirely.
